big_case.notes: Single-plaintiff section 1981 restaurant dress-code suit; unpublished Fifth Circuit per curiam applying existing circuit precedent on summary judgment; no brief in opposition, no amici, no call for a response; denied without comment or noted dissent at the long conference. The underlying question (what section 1981(b)'s 'benefits, privileges, terms, and conditions' cover during a meal) has some doctrinal interest, but nothing about this vehicle or the Court's handling of it suggests stakes beyond the parties.
